Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Content: In guest mode, PlanIt stores the schedule locally on the device. After sign-in, schedules synchronize with Firebase and also retain a local copy.
Privacy.section2Content: PlanIt supports email and password, Google Sign-In, and Apple Sign-In on compatible platforms. Authentication data is handled by Firebase Authentication.
Privacy.section3Content: Native builds include Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, and Google Mobile Ads. The full policy describes device data, advertising identifiers, third-party services, retention, and user rights.
Privacy.officialDocument: Open the application's full privacy policy

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Content: PlanIt is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. The service or individual features may be changed or discontinued.
Terms.section2Content: Users are responsible for the legality of information they add to schedules, including teacher contacts, links, and notes. Important data should also be backed up independently.
Terms.section3Content: PlanIt may be available through web and native platform distribution channels. Availability can vary by platform and region.
Terms.officialDocument: Open the application's full terms of service

CookieConsent.title: We value your privacy
CookieConsent.description: We use optional cookies and Firebase Analytics only to understand site traffic and improve PlanIt. Analytics stays off unless you accept.

errors.passwordRequirements: Firebase rejected the password because it does not meet the project's security policy.

errors.passwordMissingUppercase: Add at least one uppercase letter to the password.
errors.passwordMissingLowercase: Add at least one lowercase letter to the password.
errors.passwordMissingNumber: Add at least one number to the password.
errors.network: We couldn’t reach the PlanIt service. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: There have been too many attempts in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.userDisabled: This account has been disabled. Contact PlanIt support.
errors.operationNotAllowed: Password sign-in is disabled for this project. Contact PlanIt support.
errors.service: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a little while.
errors.unknownFirebase: Firebase returned error {code}. Share this code with PlanIt support.
